_doc: ROIs for the Quake start-map archway torch-presence gate. See docs/misc/2026-09-03-quake-torch-regression-archaeology.md section 5.1.
_scale_rule: multiply all boxes by (frame_width / 1920); HDMI tick grabs are 3840x2160 -> factor 2
_box_format: [x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive-exclusive, in the 1920x1080 basis
_pass_rule: for each require:true ROI, count pixels with R>180 && R>G+40 && G>B+20 (flame fullbright core); ROI passes at >=8 such pixels; the frame passes when both required ROIs pass; the CYCLE passes when >=2 tick frames pass (the flame animates and single frames can tear)

rois._why: DO NOT COUNT THIS. It is a MOVING projectile on a periodic timer, so it is present in some frames and absent in others, and it looks like an orange/red flame. On 2026-08-22 this decoy was mistaken for a restored wall torch and closed the bug on a false positive (grab 20260822-200435-vkq-torchfix-tick.png). It is listed here only so a future checker excludes it explicitly.
